overview: Based on the published agenda, the Wausau School District Board of Education was scheduled to convene in closed session on November 2, 2026, to hold a pupil expulsion hearing pursuant to Wisconsin Statutes sections 19.85 and 118.125. The Board was expected to hear evidence and deliberate on the expulsion matter, with possible action to be taken in closed session.

agenda.item: Motion to convene in closed session pursuant to s. 19.85(1)(a), (f), and (g), and s. 118.125 of the Wisconsin Statutes to hold a pupil expulsion hearing

discussions.body: The Board was scheduled to convene in closed session to hold a pupil expulsion hearing under Wisconsin Statutes sections 19.85(1)(a), (f), and (g), and section 118.125. Following the hearing, the Board was expected to deliberate privately and potentially take action in closed session as necessary and appropriate before reconvening in open session.

publicComment: No public comment period was included on this agenda.
actionItems: Board was expected to vote on a motion to convene in closed session for the pupil expulsion hearing
Board was expected to consider action on the expulsion matter in closed session
Board was expected to vote on a motion to reconvene in open session following the closed session
